correctness.rationale: The normalized spherical Dirichlet moment recurrence M_{a+2,b}=(a+1)M_{a,b}/(d+a+b) fixes every Gram entry, including transverse-coordinate squares. The band of dimension d(d+3)/2 splits orthogonally under O(d−2) and x1↔x2 into scalar-symmetric dimension 4, scalar-antisymmetric dimension 2, (d−2) vector pairs plus (d−2) antisymmetric vectors, and traceless transverse quadratics of dimension d(d−3)/2; their dimensions sum correctly for d>=3. Exact determinant/inertia at lambda=1/4 yields two scalar above/two below, one in each vector pair, one antisymmetric-scalar on either side; trace and the explicit p_d=(1+sqrt(d)u)(1+sqrt(d)v) trial Rayleigh quotient >3/4 isolate a single simple top root. Gamma log-convexity yields eta²>1/16, so the upper transverse-vector root >1/2, while other non-top roots <1/2; all spectrum is strictly in (0,1) by polynomial unique continuation. Independently constructed unreduced Gram matrices for dimensions 3..11 (not just supplied reduced blocks) gave the precise four interval counts and simple top root on every tested d. These finite checks support, not replace, the all-dimension moment/inertia proof.
